```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(solarrfigs)
model <- Bologna$model
```


# fig_acf

```{r}
x <- rnorm(5000)
fig_acf(x, label = "\\tilde{Y}_t", ci_color = "black", lag_max = 100)
```

# fig_ghi_year

```{r}
fig_ghi_year(model, nyear = 2019)
fig_ghi_year(model, nyear = 2019, seasonal_mean = FALSE)
fig_ghi_year(model, nyear = 2019, seasonal_mean = FALSE, clearsky = FALSE)
fig_ghi_year(model, interval = c("2020-04-01", "2020-09-22"))
fig_ghi_year(model, interval = c("2020-04-01", "2020-09-22"), legend.position = "none", legend.justification = NULL, labels = TRUE)
```
